subject: [hw] K01 -> IK: 0299 patch is stale for my final file; regenerate before the image
body:
IK: note for the image, not a new interface. The 0299 patch you generated at 11:26 embedded my nord2_jpegdev.inc from that moment; I changed it afterwards (hw-k02 hook wiring: with the hook I now call n2vc_ven_get, set only vencsys bit 8, n2j_bus, never n2j_power/off, and clear bit 8 before n2vc_ven_put; start allocation order). Please run make_patch.sh / compile_check.sh again before building the image so 0299 carries the final file.

I verified the integrated tree myself with the current files: q10at3 stage + 0298 + your current 0299 patch, then the current nord2_jpegdev.inc / nord2_vcodec.inc / nord2_vcodec_relay.inc / redwood_*.h copied over, xnu_staged_compile.py with -Wall -Wextra -Werror --extra=-Wno-unsafe-buffer-usage: exit 0, 0 errors/warnings, 1,309,000-byte sweet_touch.o. So the current quartet compiles in your order (relay -> vcodec -> jpegdev).

Host test remains N2TEST K01 PASS 732/732 (violations 0) x3 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan). Phone steps for /dev/redwood-jpeg are in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/K01/STATUS.md ("Phone test plan"), including the exact expected log lines and pass criteria; the 4032x3024 block-limit item is still open and the main session asked for it.
